svg.title: One code, three addresses
svg.desc: A Windows PC running Share Manager shares D:\Media over SFTP at 192.168.1.20:2222 and produces a QR code or an .fmscfg file. The phone that scanned it receives three addresses and tries them at once: the home Wi-Fi address 192.168.1.20:2222, the IPv6 address 2001:db8:25::20 and the internet address myhome.example.net:2222 through the router's forwarded port. It uses the fastest one that answers.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Share Manager writes every way to reach your PC into one QR code or .fmscfg file

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: All three are tried at once - preferred in the order 1, 2, 3
